test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

What is the name of the Swami whom autobiography impressed you so much?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Whom autobiography. i.e. this part contains an error.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace **whom **with **whose**.
 
• 'Whom' is an object pronoun that refers to the person who was the recipient of an action. 
 
 
• Whom do you like best?
 
 
 
• '**Whose**' is a possessive pronoun that refers to the person to whom something belongs.
 
 
• ​**Whose **book is this?
 
 
 
• Here, we need a possessive pronoun that refers to** the Swami.**
 
• Hence, **Option 2** is the correct answer.

 

**The correct sentence is:** What is the name of the swami **whose **autobiography impressed you so much?
